verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Extend exposes itself AS an MCP server (docs.extend.ai/mcp, mcp.extend.ai/mcp) so external AI agents can call Extend's document-processing tools — this is the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers INTO Extend so Extend can use their tools. No evidence describes Extend acting as an MCP client or supporting third-party tool/server integration.
